rules: Use organizer primary sources when available; label calendar-only entries provisional.
Do not promote 2026 route material to the 2027 edition.
A route map control or PDF is not binary GPX validation.
Do not delete or overwrite old GPX files until a new official binary has been downloaded, parsed and validated.
Audit-only: no app runtime or live event records changed.
